column1: # TEST FIXTURES. These strings exist to break the tokenizer, nothing else.
# They are NOT the project benchmark prompt set and imply nothing about it:
# the prompt set and its token counts are Stage 3's decision, PERSISTENT.md
# section 1, D3. Nothing here is timed and no token count here is a result.
# Format: three tab-separated columns, one record per line.
#   2  the record itself, hex encoded, two lower-case hex digits per byte,
#      empty for the empty record. Hex because the corpus carries embedded
#      NUL bytes and byte sequences that are not valid UTF-8, which no text
#      encoding can carry identically into both C and Python.
#   3  a label, for the reader. Never parsed.
# Required class tags, one row minimum each, asserted by test_tokenizer:

column3: NON-BMP: the highest codepoint there is
no-break space, a whitespace codepoint above ASCII
a whitespace run that reaches end of input
a whitespace run at the end after text
runs of two, three and four between words
em space inside an ASCII whitespace run
a mixed whitespace run at end of input
the string the previous record is a prefix of
the special token string wedged into text
the special token string with spaces around it
the same shape, but not a declared token
two bytes that never appear in UTF-8
a stray continuation byte inside ASCII
the UTF-8 encoding of a surrogate, which is ill-formed
